SELECT ticket_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'opened' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'assigned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_assigned,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_resolved,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'opened' THEN event_time END) AS opened_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'assigned' THEN event_time END) AS assigned_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'resolved' THEN event_time END) AS resolved_time
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_time) = 2025
    GROUP BY ticket_id
    HAVING
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'opened' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'assigned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'opened' THEN event_time END) <= MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'assigned' THEN event_time END) AND
        MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'assigned' THEN event_time END) <= MAX(CASE WHEN state = 'resolved' THEN event_time END)
)
ORDER BY ticket_id

representative_candidate_diffs.candidate_sql:
WITH funnel_steps AS (
  SELECT 'accepted' AS step, 1 AS step_num UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sorted', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dispatched', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'delivered', 4
),
parcel_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    occurred_at,
    status,
    amount,
    sequence,
    LAG(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY occurred_at, sequence) AS prev_occurred_at,
    LAG(sequence) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY occurred_at, sequence) AS prev_sequence
  FROM parcel_scans
  WHERE occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < '2026-01-01'
),
sessionized AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    occurred_at,
    status,
    amount,
    sequence,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_occurred_at IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN occurred_at - prev_occurred_at > INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1
      WHEN sequence <> prev_sequence + 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_session
  FROM parcel_sessions
),
session_groups AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY occurred_at, sequence) AS session_id
  FROM sessionized
),
step_progress AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    session_id,
    step_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status = step THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_completed
  FROM session_groups sg
  JOIN funnel_steps fs ON 1=1
  GROUP BY entity_id, group_key, session_id, step_num
),
funnel_completion AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    session_id,
    MAX(step_num) AS max_step_completed
  FROM step_progress
  GROUP BY entity_id, group_key, session_id
),
delivered_parcels AS (
  SELECT
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    session_id,
    amount
  FROM session_groups sg
  JOIN funnel_completion fc ON sg.entity_id = fc.entity_id AND sg.group_key = fc.group_key AND sg.session_id = fc.session_id
  WHERE status = 'delivered' AND max_step_completed = 4
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    group_key,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM delivered_parcels
  GROUP BY group_key
)
SELECT group_key, total_amount FROM result ORDER BY group_key

WITH funnel_steps AS (
  SELECT
    'accepted' AS step,
    1 AS step_order
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sorted', 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatched', 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 'delivered', 4
),
parcel_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    record_id,
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    occurred_at,
    status,
    amount,
    sequence,
    LAG(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id, group_key ORDER BY occurred_at, sequence) AS prev_occurred_at,
    LAG(status) OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id, group_key ORDER BY occurred_at, sequence) AS prev_status
  FROM parcel_scans
),
eligible_parcels AS (
  SELECT
    record_id,
    entity_id,
    group_key,
    occurred_at,
    status,
    amount,
    sequence,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_occurred_at IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN prev_status = status THEN 1
      WHEN occurred_at - prev_occurred_at > INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_session
  FROM parcel_sessions
),
funnel_progress AS (
  SELECT
    f.step,
    f.step_order,
    e.group_key,
    e.occurred_at,
    e.status,
    e.amount,
    e.sequence,
    e.is_new_session,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.status = f.step THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.group_key, e.entity_id
      ORDER BY e.occurred_at, e.sequence
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ) AS prev_step_completed
  FROM funnel_steps f
  JOIN eligible_parcels e ON f.step = e.status
  WHERE e.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND e.occurred_at < '2026-01-01'
),
delivered_parcels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    group_key,
    entity_id
  FROM funnel_progress
  WHERE step = 'delivered' AND prev_step_completed = 1
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    dp.group_key,
    SUM(ps.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM delivered_parcels dp
  JOIN parcel_scans ps ON dp.entity_id = ps.entity_id AND ps.status = 'accepted'
  WHERE ps.occurred_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ps.occurred_at < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY dp.group_key
)
SELECT group_key, total_amount FROM result ORDER BY group_key

WITH step_order AS (
  SELECT
    event_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE event_type
      WHEN 'view' THEN 0
      WHEN 'add_to_cart' THEN 1
      WHEN 'checkout' THEN 2
      WHEN 'purchase' THEN 3
      ELSE 4 END) AS step_num
  FROM (VALUES ('view'), ('add_to_cart'), ('checkout'), ('purchase')) AS t(event_type)
),
customer_steps AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_time,
    e.event_id,
    so.step_num
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN events e ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN step_order so ON e.event_type = so.event_type
),
ranked_steps AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    event_type,
    step_num,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY event_time, event_id
    ) AS time_rank
  FROM customer_steps
  WHERE step_num <= 4
),
first_occurrences AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    step_num,
    time_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      step_num,
      time_rank,
      LAG(step_num) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY time_rank) AS prev_step_num
    FROM ranked_steps
  ) t
  WHERE prev_step_num IS NULL OR step_num = prev_step_num + 1
),
max_step AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(step_num) AS max_step_reached
  FROM first_occurrences
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  COALESCE(m.max_step_reached, 0) AS max_step_reached,
  COALESCE(m.max_step_reached, 0) = 4 AS completed
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN max_step m ON c.customer_id = m.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id

WITH step_order AS (
  SELECT event_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE event_type
    WHEN 'view' THEN 1
    WHEN 'add_to_cart' THEN 2
    WHEN 'checkout' THEN 3
    WHEN 'purchase' THEN 4
    ELSE 5 END) AS step_num
  FROM (VALUES ('view'), ('add_to_cart'), ('checkout'), ('purchase')) AS t(event_type)
),
customer_steps AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_time,
    e.event_id,
    so.step_num
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN events e ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN step_order so ON e.event_type = so.event_type
  WHERE so.step_num <= 4
),
ranked_steps AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    event_id,
    step_num,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id, step_num
      ORDER BY event_time, event_id
    ) AS first_occurrence
  FROM customer_steps
  WHERE step_num IS NOT NULL
),
first_occurrences AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    event_id,
    step_num,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY event_time, event_id
    ) AS global_rank
  FROM ranked_steps
  WHERE first_occurrence = 1
),
chain_progress AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(step_num) AS max_step_reached
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      step_num,
      LAG(step_num) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY global_rank) AS prev_step_num
    FROM first_occurrences
  )
  WHERE prev_step_num IS NULL OR step_num = prev_step_num + 1
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  COALESCE(cp.max_step_reached, 0) AS max_step_reached,
  COALESCE(cp.max_step_reached, 0) = 4 AS completed
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN chain_progress cp ON c.customer_id = cp.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN e1.event_type = 'view' THEN 1
                WHEN e1.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e2.event_type = 'view' THEN 2
                WHEN e1.event_type = 'checkout' AND e2.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e3.event_type = 'view' THEN 3
                WHEN e1.event_type = 'purchase' AND e2.event_type = 'checkout' AND e3.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e4.event_type = 'view' THEN 4
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0
    ) AS max_step_reached,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN e1.event_type = 'purchase' AND e2.event_type = 'checkout' AND e3.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e4.event_type = 'view' THEN TRUE
                ELSE FALSE
            END
        ), FALSE
    ) AS completed
FROM
    customers c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.event_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.customer_id, e.event_type ORDER BY e.event_time, e.event_id) AS rn
    FROM
        events e
    WHERE
        e.customer_id = c.customer_id
) e1 ON e1.rn = 1 AND e1.event_type = 'view'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.event_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.customer_id, e.event_type ORDER BY e.event_time, e.event_id) AS rn
    FROM
        events e
    WHERE
        e.customer_id = c.customer_id
) e2 ON e2.rn = 1 AND e2.event_type = 'add_to_cart' AND e2.event_time >= e1.event_time
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.event_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.customer_id, e.event_type ORDER BY e.event_time, e.event_id) AS rn
    FROM
        events e
    WHERE
        e.customer_id = c.customer_id
) e3 ON e3.rn = 1 AND e3.event_type = 'checkout' AND e3.event_time >= e2.event_time
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.event_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.customer_id, e.event_type ORDER BY e.event_time, e.event_id) AS rn
    FROM
        events e
    WHERE
        e.customer_id = c.customer_id
) e4 ON e4.rn = 1 AND e4.event_type = 'purchase' AND e4.event_time >= e3.event_time
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id
ORDER BY
    c.customer_id
